comment: The single source of the exact versions a paved-road app starts with. create writes these into package.json; verify reports any drift from them. The layer is installed from its GitHub Release, not a registry.

overridesReason.simple-git: Critical advisories in the 3.x line Nuxt's devtools pulls in; 4.0.2 is the fixed release. Devtools is off in the template. Drop when Nuxt depends on a fixed version.
overridesReason.@simple-git/argv-parser: Critical advisory below 2.0.1, pulled in by simple-git. Drop with the simple-git override.
